scenarios.name: Load probe: --plugin-dir overrides the installed craftflow
scenarios.given: an empty scratch project with a .craftflow/state dir, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pointing at the scratch project
scenarios.when: claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/craftflow --model haiku --debug-file <file> runs a one-word prompt
scenarios.then: the debug log contains 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' at least once, proving the worktree plugin (not the installed one) is what the live scenarios exercise
scenarios.command: SCR=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$SCR/p1/.craftflow/state" && PLUGIN="$PWD/plugins/craftflow" && (cd "$SCR/p1" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$SCR/p1" claude -p --plugin-dir "$PLUGIN" --model haiku --debug-file "$SCR/dbg.txt" "Reply OK" >/dev/null 2>&1); N=$(grep -c 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' "$SCR/dbg.txt"); rm -rf "$SCR"; echo "load_probe_hits=$N"; test "$N" -ge 1

scenarios.name: Stop gate LV-1..LV-6
scenarios.given: the worktree plugin loaded via --plugin-dir with its shipped stop-gate config UNCHANGED (mode off), scratch git projects with a seeded BUILD workflow artifact (one with a pending gate), scratch user-config files reached through CRAFTFLOW_STOP_GATE_USER_CONFIG, a loopback Jev stub reached through a jev-endpoint.json in an isolated scratch home (injected by a scratch-plugin hook wrapper that pins the Jev client's passwd home), and scratch plugin copies for the relay (test-only consent override) and the stop_hook_active probe
scenarios.when: stop_gate_roundtrip.py drives real haiku sessions: the shipped plugin is inert (LV-1), audit writes one shadow row and the agent still stops (LV-2), a pending gate forces needs_human via H03 (LV-3), a repository-set jevText never reaches the Jev stub (LV-4), the push relay asks for exactly one PushNotification through a scratch consent home (LV-5), and a probe hook records stop_hook_active across chained continuations (LV-6)
scenarios.then: the driver prints the summary JSON with load_probe PASS, lv1..lv4 PASS, lv5 PASS or LIMITATION:push_tool_unavailable_headless, lv5_limitation push_requires_consent_file, lv6 RECORDED, the observed stop_hook_active_chain value, plugin_config_unchanged true and evidence_class A, leaves the real consent file untouched, and exits 0

scenarios.name: Stop gate timing
scenarios.given: a 1 MiB transcript, a 90 KB workflow artifact and a git repo with 200 files in a temp project, with the hook run in mode off and mode audit (no Jev) next to a bare python3 -c pass
scenarios.when: stop_gate_timing.py runs 20 interleaved bare / off / audit subprocess rounds
scenarios.then: off delta median <= 10 ms and audit delta median <= 150 ms over bare python when the 1-minute load is at most the CPU count, otherwise absolute_gate is inconclusive_load (disclosed, never converted to a pass); every run exits 0 with no stdout and audit appends exactly one bound row per run
scenarios.expected: exit 0; gate_pass true or absolute_gate inconclusive_load

scenarios.name: Stop gate continue ACT LA-1..LA-8
scenarios.given: the worktree plugin loaded via --plugin-dir, its shipped stop-gate config UNCHANGED (mode off), a scratch plugin copy whose Stop hook command runs the real hook with the passwd home (consent file and user layer) pointed at a scratch home and the Jev endpoint-override blocker A09 lifted, a loopback Jev stub answering phase_done 0.97 / needs_human 0.05, a fake key, seeded GO events armed through the real arm CLI, and artifacts stamped with the uuid passed via --session-id
scenarios.when: stop_gate_act_roundtrip.py drives real haiku sessions: shipped plugin inert (LA-1), the helper --session-id equals the session uuid (LA-2), unarmed on never acts (LA-3), armed acts once then stops on H16 (LA-4), max 2 acts twice then stops on H17 with progress between turns (LA-5, up to 2 retries), an outward next phase stops on H10 (LA-6), a model touching the consent file disarms through ctime (LA-7), and stop_reason / prompt_id stability across a chain are recorded (LA-8)
scenarios.then: the driver prints the summary JSON with la1..la7 PASS, la8 RECORDED, act_hook_ms_p90 <= 1500, real_consent_unchanged true, plugin_config_unchanged true, evidence_class A and the limitations act_requires_consent_file, act_go_from_seeded_events, jev_stub_endpoint_test_allowance, and exits 0

scenarios.name: Stop gate continue ACT timing
scenarios.given: the same scratch plugin copy, scratch homes armed through the real arm CLI and a loopback Jev stub, one fresh git project per run, no model calls
scenarios.when: stop_gate_act_roundtrip.py --timing-only runs the wrapped hook 20 times, each against a fresh armed project
scenarios.then: every run acts (one acted row) and the ACT hook_ms p90 is at most 1500 ms; the real consent file is untouched
